name: 草莓猫
look: A dusty strawberry-pink triangular neckerchief with two tiny cream dots and a small strawberry-shaped cloth hair clip beside one ear. Keep the eyes, face and body exposed.
act: Seated front three-quarter view: frame 12 holds one ripe red strawberry low in both forepaws and looks at it; frame 13 raises it to mouth with small open mouth; frame 14 bites a little piece off it; frame 15 lowers the bitten strawberry and smiles with closed eyes.

name: 水手猫
look: A small cream sailor cap with a muted blue band between the ears, and a navy-and-cream striped sailor collar with a tiny blue tie. Face and chunky gray body remain exposed.
act: Seated front three-quarter view: frame 12 rests both forepaws low; frame 13 lifts the near paw next to the cheek; frame 14 extends that paw outward in a friendly wave with visible pads; frame 15 brings it back inward and smiles. The other paw and rump stay planted.

name: 星星猫
look: A soft lavender small floppy pointed wizard hat decorated with a cream crescent, and a short lavender shoulder cape tied with a cream star button. Both ears are visible, all face markings and green eyes stay exposed.
act: Seated front three-quarter view: frame 12 holds a short wooden wand with a solid yellow star tip low; frame 13 raises the wand diagonally; frame 14 gently sweeps it to the right; frame 15 brings it back to the chest and smiles. No floating sparkles or effects; the star is a physical wand tip.

name: 园丁猫
look: A soft sage-green short gardening apron with a cream pocket, and one small straw sunhat with a muted green band tilted between the ears. Keep the gray-and-apricot face, legs and tail visible.
act: Seated front three-quarter view: a single tiny terracotta pot with one yellow flower stays beside the forepaws in all four frames. Frame 12 holds a small sage watering can low; frame 13 lifts the can; frame 14 tilts it above the flower with two opaque blue water drops; frame 15 brings the can upright and smiles. Keep pot and body baseline fixed.

name: 面包猫
look: A little warm-cream baker cap with a caramel band and a short pale apricot apron with a tiny wheat motif. The original gray tortoiseshell head, chunky body and striped tail remain recognizable.
act: Seated front three-quarter view: one small light wooden kneading board and one cream dough ball rest directly in front at ground level. Frame 12 both forepaws hover over the dough; frame 13 presses it down; frame 14 folds it with bent forelegs; frame 15 lifts paws slightly and smiles at the round dough. Four visibly different paw and dough poses.

name: 侦探猫
look: A tiny oatmeal brown deerstalker detective cap and short tan cape with a dark cocoa button. Both ears peek out, no face covering. Green eyes and asymmetrical apricot brow patch stay visible.
act: Seated front three-quarter view: frame 12 holds a small cocoa-handled round magnifying glass beside its chest; frame 13 raises it toward one eye; frame 14 leans forward peering through the glass with one visible enlarged green eye; frame 15 lowers the glass and perks up. The lens is a simple pale flat blue tint, no photorealistic refraction.

name: 邮差猫
look: A small muted teal postman's cap with a tiny cream envelope badge and a caramel crossbody mail satchel. Keep straps simple, both ears showing, original gray fur and peach markings exposed.
act: Seated front three-quarter view: frame 12 looks down at the satchel; frame 13 pulls out a cream envelope with one small pink heart seal; frame 14 extends it forward in both forepaws; frame 15 hugs the envelope to its chest with smiling eyes. The satchel stays attached in every frame.

name: 抱抱猫
look: A tiny dusty peach sleeping cap with a soft cream pompom and a matching small peach neck scarf with one cream stripe. Do not cover or change the cat's face markings.
act: Seated front three-quarter view: frame 12 holds a small pale blue fish-shaped fabric plush low; frame 13 lifts the plush to its cheek; frame 14 hugs it with both forepaws and closes eyes; frame 15 rests its cheek on the plush, smiling. The fish is a toy with a stitched eye, no second animal.

name: 探险猫
look: A burnt-orange small neckerchief, a miniature khaki canvas backpack, and simple round aviator-style goggles resting on the forehead above the ears, never covering the green eyes. No footwear.
act: Seated front three-quarter view: frame 12 holds a folded cream paper map low; frame 13 opens the map with both paws; frame 14 studies it with a curious head tilt; frame 15 points one paw to a small red X on the open map. Map has only a few simple colored paths, no lettering.
